items.title: 6.11 Real Life Problems involving Sequences and Series (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Ab tak hum ne sequences aur series ko kitaabi numbers mein dekha. Is aakhri hisse mein kitab dikhati hai ke yahi A.P. aur G.P. rozmarra zindagi mein kahan kaam aati hain: qarz (loan) par sood (interest), bachat, website design, aur gaari ki qiston (lease payments) mein. Yahan math naya nahin; asal hunar alfaaz ko sequence mein badalna hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Har sawal mein do sawal khud se poochiye:
(1) Kya miqdaar har dafa ek hi raqam jama hone se badal rahi hai (A.P.), ya har dafa ek hi number se multiply ho rahi hai (G.P.)? Misaal: har mahine Rs. 500 zyada qist = A.P.; har saal 5% barhna = G.P.
(2) Sawal kisi ek khaas term ka poochh raha hai ("24th month mein kitni qist") ya kul jama ("total kitna diya")? Pehle ke liye \(a_{n}\), doosre ke liye \(S_{n}\).

rows: Amount grows by the same number each step (simple interest, fixed increase)
Amount grows by the same percentage each step (compound interest, growth)

blocks.title: Example 28
blocks.problem:
Vehicle Arrival Sequence
Vehicles arrive at a toll booth at a rate of 4 cars every 5 minutes. Represent the number
steps: Kitab mein chhapa nahin: page is jumle ke beech mein hi khatam ho jata hai aur baaqi page khaali hai. Is liye sawal ka baaqi hissa aur us ka hal yahan nahin diya ja sakta (neeche wala box dekhiye).

blocks.title: Kitab mein missing
blocks.text: Kitab mein Example 28 jumle ke beech mein ruk jata hai ("... Represent the number"); baaqi page khaali hai aur agla page naye heading se shuru hota hai. Sawal ka baaqi hissa aur poora hal chhapa hi nahin. Hum ne gayab hissa apni taraf se nahin banaya; poora sawal apne teacher se poochh lein.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Pehle chand alfaaz samajh lein jo agli misaalon mein baar baar aayenge. Principal (asal raqam) woh raqam hai jo qarz li ya invest ki gayi. Rate (sharah) batata hai ke har saal sau rupay par kitna interest (sood / munafa) banta hai; 8% ka matlab har Rs. 100 par Rs. 8 salana. Simple interest mein interest hamesha sirf asal raqam par lagta hai, is liye har saal barabar raqam jama hoti hai: yeh A.P. hai. Compound interest mein har saal ka interest asal raqam mein jud jata hai aur agle saal us par bhi interest lagta hai: is liye raqam har saal ek hi factor se multiply hoti hai, yani G.P.
Ab pehli misaal: qarz par simple interest. Yahan humein kul interest chahiye, aur hum dekhenge ke saal ba saal kul interest ek A.P. banata hai.
Simple Interest on Loan (Arithmetic Sequence with Particular Term)

blocks.title: Example 29
blocks.problem: To buy furniture for a new apartment Tayyab borrowed Rs. 50,000 at 8% simple interest for 11 years. How much interest will he pay?
steps:
Given: principal (asal raqam) Rs. 50,000, simple interest ki sharah 8% salana, waqt 11 saal.
To find: 11 saal baad kul interest.
Method: simple interest mein har saal ek hi raqam (asal raqam par) interest banti hai. Is liye 1, 2, 3, ... saal ke baad kul interest A.P. banata hai, aur humein is ki \(11^{\text{th}}\) term chahiye.

Step 1: Pehle aur doosre saal ke baad interest
\[50000 \times \dfrac{8}{100} \times 1 = 4000\]
\[50000 \times \dfrac{8}{100} \times 2 = 8000\]
Kyun: simple interest = principal \(\times\) rate \(\times\) time. Simple interest hamesha asal Rs. 50,000 par hi lagta hai, pichle interest par nahin.

Step 2: A.P. pehchaanein
\[4000, 8000, 12000, \dots\]
\[a_{1} = 4000,\ d = 8000 - 4000 = 4000\]
\[n = 11\]
Kyun: har saal wahi Rs. 4000 jama ho rahe hain, yani common difference.

Step 3: \(11^{\text{th}}\) term
\[a_{n} = a_{1} + (n-1)d\]
\[a_{11} = 4000 + (11-1)(4000)\]
\[= 4000 + 10(4000)\]
\[= 4000 + 40000 = 44000\]
Kyun: 11 saal ke baad ka kul interest A.P. ki gyarvi term hai. Dhyan dein: yahan sum nahin lena, kyun ke har term pehle se kul (cumulative) interest hai.

Tasdeeq:
\[50000 \times \dfrac{8}{100} \times 11 = 44000\]
Simple interest ka seedha formula bhi wahi jawab deta hai.
blocks.answer: Tayyab 11 saal mein Rs. 50,000 ke qarz par kul Rs. 44000 interest dega.

blocks.text: Ab doosri qism ka interest dekhte hain jo bank accounts aur investments mein aam hai: compound interest. Yahan ghor se dekhiyega ke har saal ki raqam pichli raqam ka ek muqarrar guna kaise banti hai, kyun ke yahi G.P. ki pehchaan hai.
Compound Interest on Loan (Geometric Sequence with Particular Term)

blocks.title: Example 30
blocks.problem: Amna invests Rs. 200000 at 5% interest compounded annually. What total amount will she get after 10 years?
steps:
Given: principal \(P = \) Rs. 200000, 5% salana, har saal compound, 10 saal.
To find: 10 saal baad kul raqam (amount).
Method: compound interest mein har saal ki raqam ko wahi factor \(1.05\) se multiply karte hain. Is liye saalana raqamein G.P. banati hain, aur humein is ki \(10^{\text{th}}\) term chahiye.

Step 1: Pehla saal
\[\text{Interest} = P \times \dfrac{5}{100} = P(0.05)\]
\[\text{Amount} = P + P(0.05) = P(1 + 0.05)\]
Kyun: saal ke aakhir mein raqam = asal raqam + us saal ka interest; \(P\) common nikaalne se \(P(1.05)\).

Step 2: Doosra saal
\[\text{Interest} = P(1 + 0.05) \times 0.05\]
\[\text{Amount} = P(1.05) + P(1.05)(0.05)\]
\[= P(1 + 0.05)(1 + 0.05)\]
\[= P(1 + 0.05)^{2}\]
Kyun: "compounded" ka matlab hai ke ab interest pehle saal ki poori raqam par lagta hai, sirf \(P\) par nahin. Yani interest par bhi interest. \(P(1.05)\) common nikaalne se phir \((1 + 0.05)\) aata hai.

Step 3: G.P. pehchaanein
Isi tarah teesre saal ke baad raqam \(P(1 + 0.05)^{3}\), to raqamein yeh hain:
\[P(1.05), P(1.05)^{2}, P(1.05)^{3}, \dots\]
G.P. jis mein \(a_{1} = P(1.05)\), \(r = 1.05\), \(n = 10\).
Kyun: har raqam pichli raqam ka \(1.05\) guna hai, yani common ratio.

Step 5: Hisaab lagayein
\[(1.05)^{10} = 1.62889\ (\text{approx.})\]
\[(200000)(1.05)^{10} = 325778.93\]
Kyun: calculator \((1.05)^{10} = 1.6288946...\) deta hai. Saare decimals ke saath \(200000 \times 1.6288946... = 325778.925...\), jo do decimal tak round karne par \(325778.93\) banta hai. Dhyan dein: agar sirf \(1.62889\) se multiply karein to \(325778.00\) aata hai; is liye calculator ki poori value istemaal karein.

Tasdeeq:
1 saal baad \(210000\), 2 saal baad \(220500\) (\(= 210000 \times 1.05\)). Har saal pichli raqam ka 5% barh raha hai, jaisa G.P. mein hona chahiye.
blocks.answer: Amna ko 10 saal baad taqreeban Rs. 325778.93 milenge (kitab Rs. 325778.92 likhti hai).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text:
1. Example 30 mein kitab ne pehli term \(a_{l} = P(1.05)\) (letter l) chhapi hai; sahi \(a_{1} = P(1.05)\) hai, yani pehli term.
2. Kitab aakhri raqam Rs. 325778.92 batati hai. Do decimal tak sahi rounding se \(200000(1.05)^{10} = 325778.925...\) yani Rs. 325778.93 banta hai (aur rounded \(1.62889\) se Rs. 325778.00). Farq sirf ek paisa hai.

Agli misaal paison ki nahin, design ki hai. Website banane wale screen ko columns mein baant te hain. Agar har column pichle se ek muqarrar miqdaar chaura ho, to widths A.P. banati hain, aur sawal kul width ka hai, yani A.P. ka sum. Is dafa hum term ki bajaye sum ka formula istemaal karenge.
Grid Column Distribution (Arithmetic Series Sum of Terms)

blocks.title: Example 31
blocks.problem: A web designer is using a 12-column grid system where each column increases in width by \(10px\) from the previous one. The first column width is \(50px\) wide. Find the total width occupied by all 12 columns.
steps:
Given: 12 columns; pehle column ki width \(50px\); har column pichle se \(10px\) chaura.
To find: saare 12 columns ki kul width.
Method: widths \(50, 60, 70, \dots\) A.P. hain, aur "total width" ka matlab sum hai. Is liye A.P. ke sum ka formula lagayenge. (\(px\) yani pixel, screen par lambai ki ikaai.)

Step 1: A.P. pehchaanein
\[a_{1} = 50,\quad d = 10,\quad n = 12\]
Kyun: "\(10px\) barhta hai" ka matlab har dafa wahi miqdaar jama hoti hai, yani common difference.

Step 2: Sum ka formula
\[S_{n} = \dfrac{n}{2}[2a_{1} + (n-1)d]\]
\[S_{12} = \dfrac{12}{2}[2(50) + (12-1)(10)]\]
Kyun: humein saari 12 terms ka jama chahiye, sirf aakhri term nahin. Yeh formula sirf \(a_{1}\), \(d\), \(n\) maangta hai jo teenon maloom hain.

Tasdeeq:
Aakhri column \(50 + 11(10) = 160px\), aur \(S_{12} = \frac{12}{2}(50 + 160) = 6 \times 210 = 1260\). Doosre formula se bhi wahi jawab.
blocks.answer: Saare 12 columns ki kul width \(1260px\) hai.

blocks.text: Aakhri misaal mein chaar hisse hain aur yeh is section ka sab se ahem sawal hai, kyun ke is mein term, sum, muqabla aur quadratic inequality, sab ek jagah aate hain. Har hisse se pehle khud se poochiye: kya yahan ek mahine ki qist chahiye (term) ya kul raqam (sum)?

blocks.title: Example 32
blocks.problem:
Motor Vehicle Leasing Using Arithmetic Sequence
A company leases a motor vehicle with the following terms:
• The first monthly payment is Rs. 15,000
• Each subsequent payment increases by Rs. 500 due to inflation adjustments.
• The lease term is 24 months.
Find:
(i) What is the payment in the \(24^{\text{th}}\) month?
(ii) What is the total amount paid over 24 months?
(iii) If the company can only afford to pay a total of Rs. 400,000, can they complete the 24-months lease?
(iv) Find maximum months \(n\) such that total, payment \(S_{n} \le 400,000\).
steps:
Given: pehli term \(a_{1} = 15000\), common difference \(d = 500\), terms \(n = 24\).
To find: (i) \(a_{24}\); (ii) \(S_{24}\); (iii) kya \(S_{24} \le 400000\); (iv) sab se bara \(n\) jis ke liye \(S_{n} \le 400000\).
Method: har mahine qist (installment) Rs. 500 barhti hai (mehngai ki wajah se), to qistein A.P. hain. (i) ek term hai, (ii) sum, (iii) muqabla, aur (iv) quadratic inequality.

Step 1 (i): \(24^{\text{th}}\) mahine ki qist
\[a_{n} = a_{1} + (n-1)d\]
\[a_{24} = 15000 + (24-1)(500)\]
\[= 15000 + 23 \times 500\]
\[= 15000 + 11500 = 26500\]
Kyun: kisi khaas mahine ki qist A.P. ki ek term hai. Dhyan dein: 24th mahine tak 23 dafa izafa hota hai, 24 dafa nahin.

Step 2 (ii): 24 mahinon ka kul
\[S_{n} = \dfrac{n}{2}(a_{1} + a_{n})\]
\[S_{24} = \dfrac{24}{2}(15000 + 26500)\]
\[= 12(41500) = 498000\]
Kyun: \(a_{24}\) pehle hi maloom hai, is liye "pehli term + aakhri term" wala formula sab se tez hai.

Step 3 (iii): Kya company afford kar sakti hai?
\[498000 > 400000\]
\[498000 - 400000 = 98000\]
Kyun: zaroori raqam budget se zyada hai, is liye jawab hai: nahin. Kami Rs. 98,000 ki hai.

Step 4 (iv): Inequality banayein
\[S_{n} = \dfrac{n}{2}[2a_{1} + (n-1)d] \le 400000\]
\[\dfrac{n}{2}[2(15000) + (n-1)(500)] \le 400000\]
Kyun: ab \(n\) maloom nahin, is liye woh sum formula lena hai jo sirf \(a_{1}\) aur \(d\) maangta hai; aakhri term ka pata nahin.

Step 5 (iv): Quadratic tak simplify
\[n[15000 + 250n - 250] \le 400000\]
\[n(250n + 14750) \le 400000\]
\[250n^{2} + 14750n - 400000 \le 0\]
\[n^{2} + 59n - 1600 \le 0\]
Kyun: bracket ko 2 se divide kiya to \(\frac{1}{2}\) khatam; phir khola, sab kuch ek taraf laye, aur \(250\) se divide kiya. \(250\) positive hai, is liye \(\le\) ka nishaan nahin palatta.

Step 6 (iv): Associated equation hal karein
\[n^{2} + 59n - 1600 = 0\]
\[n = \dfrac{-59 \pm \sqrt{(59)^{2} - 4(1)(-1600)}}{2(1)}\]
\[n = \dfrac{-59 \pm 99.4}{2}\]
\[n = -79.2,\quad n = 20.2\]
Kyun: quadratic formula batata hai ke expression kahan zero hota hai; \(\sqrt{3481 + 6400} = \sqrt{9881} \approx 99.4\).

Step 7 (iv): \(n\) chunein
Expression roots ke darmiyan \(\le 0\) hota hai, yani \(-79.2 \le n \le 20.2\). Mahine positive poore number hote hain, is liye sab se bara
\[n = 20\]
Kyun: \(n = 20\) inequality poori karta hai, \(n = 21\) nahin. \(20.2\) ko upar round kar ke \(21\) lena ghalat hoga.
blocks.answer: (i) Rs. 26500; (ii) Rs. 498000; (iii) Nahin, kul raqam budget se Rs. 98,000 zyada hai; (iv) \(n = 20\) mahine.

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Hissa (iv) mein inequality \(n^{2} + 59n - 1600 \le 0\) ka matlab samjhein. Graph sochiye: \(y = n^{2} + 59n - 1600\) ek upar khulne wali parabola (U shakal) hai jo do roots \(-79.2\) aur \(20.2\) par x-axis ko kaatti hai. Roots ke darmiyan graph x-axis ke neeche hai, yani expression negative ya zero. Is liye jawab roots ke beech wali values hain. Phir haqeeqat ki shart lagaiye: mahine na negative ho sakte hain na adhoore, to sirf \(1, 2, \dots, 20\) bachte hain, aur un mein sab se bara \(20\) hai. Hamesha aakhri jawab ko \(S_{20}\) aur \(S_{21}\) se check kar lein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Example 32 (ii) mein kitab ne formula \(S_{n} = \frac{n}{2}(a_{n} + a_{n})\) chhapa hai. Sahi formula \(S_{n} = \frac{n}{2}(a_{1} + a_{n})\) hai (pehli term + aakhri term). Kitab ke numbers \(\frac{24}{2}(15000 + 26500)\) pehle hi sahi formula se hain.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ka sawal nahin. Rs. 20,000 par 10% simple interest: har saal Rs. 2000, to 5 saal ke kul interests \(2000, 4000, 6000, 8000, 10000\) (A.P.).
Rs. 10,000 par 10% compound interest, 3 saal: \(10000(1.1)^{3} = 13310\) (G.P.).
Farq dekhiye: simple mein har saal barabar izafa, compound mein har saal izafa khud barhta jata hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Agar Example 32 mein qist har mahine Rs. 500 barhne ki bajaye 2% barhti, to kaun si sequence hoti? (Jawab: G.P., \(r = 1.02\).) Aur agar sawal hota "20th mahine mein kitni qist", to kya aap sum lagate ya term? (Term!)

Is section se sab se bara sabaq yeh hai ke zindagi ke sawal pehle se "A.P." ya "G.P." likh kar nahin aate. Aap ko khud alfaaz parh kar faisla karna hota hai: "har mahine Rs. 500 zyada" = barabar izafa = A.P.; "5% compounded" = barabar guna = G.P.; "kitna total" = sum; "20th mahine mein" = term. Yeh chaar faisle sahi ho jayen to baaqi kaam wahi formulas hain jo aap pehle se jaante hain. Exercise 6.11 mein isi tarah ke sawal hain: qiston, aabadi ke barhne, tankee se paani ke rasne aur toll plaza ki gaariyon par.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Har qadam par barabar izafa (simple interest, har mahine Rs. 500 zyada, 10px chaura): A.P.
2. Har qadam par barabar percentage izafa (compound interest): G.P., \(r = 1 + \frac{\text{rate}}{100}\).
3. "\(n^{\text{th}}\) mahine mein / \(n\) saal baad" = term; "total / kul" = sum.
4. Jab sum mein \(n\) unknown ho to quadratic banta hai; sirf woh positive poora number lein jo shart poori kare.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Compound interest par A.P. ka formula lagana: compound mein multiply hota hai, is liye G.P.
2. Total poocha ho aur aakhri term de dena (Example 31 mein saare 12 columns chahiye, sirf 12th nahin).
3. \(n = 20.2\) ko \(21\) bana dena: \(S_{21}\) budget se zyada hai. Neeche round karein aur check karein.
4. \(5\%\) ko \(5\) ya \(1.5\) likhna: growth factor \(1 + 0.05 = 1.05\) hai.
